headings: "Pet humanization" and premiumization driving higher spending per pet
Historical and projected growth in pet spending
Consistency of spending and resilience during economic downturns
Rapid shift to online shopping, with significant remaining opportunity
paragraphs: Chewy, Inc. began operating as Chewy.com in 2011 and Chewy.com, LLC was formed as a Delaware limited liability company in October 2013. On March 16, 2016, Chewy.com, LLC converted from a Delaware limited liability company to a Delaware corporation and changed its name to Chewy, Inc. Chewy, Inc. completed the initial public offering of its Class A common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the "Class A common stock"), on June 18, 2019. Unless the context requires otherwise, references in this Annual Report on Form 10-K to "Chewy," the "Company," "we," "our," or "us" refer to Chewy, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries.

Our mission is to be the most trusted and convenient destination for pet parents and partners everywhere. We believe that we are the preeminent online source for pet products, supplies and prescriptions as a result of our broad selection of high-quality products and services, which we offer at competitive prices and deliver with an exceptional level of care and a personal touch to build brand loyalty and drive repeat purchasing. We seek to continually develop innovative ways for our customers to engage with us, as our websites and mobile applications allow our pet parents to manage their pets' health, wellness, and merchandise needs, while enabling them to conveniently shop for our products. We partner with approximately 4,000 of the best and most trusted brands in the pet industry, and we create and offer our own private brands. Through our websites and mobile applications, we offer our customers approximately 190,000 products and services offerings, to bring what we believe is a high-bar, customer-centric experience to our customers. By leveraging our extensive supply chain infrastructure consisting of fulfillment centers located in the U.S. and Canada, we are typically able to offer our products in a localized manner with the capability to serve over 80% of the U.S. population overnight and almost 100% in two days.
We operate in the large and growing pet industry, which consists of pet food and treats, pet supplies and pet medications, other pet-health products, and pet services.

Pet parents increasingly view pets as part of the family and are willing to spend more on higher-quality goods and services for those family members. According to research conducted by Packaged Facts, 93% of pet owners in the U.S. consider their pets to be a part of their family. Additionally, 86% of pet owners agree with the statement that pets are central to their home life, and 74% would go as far as to say they consider themselves a "pet parent." Furthermore, according to Packaged Facts, three-quarters of pet parents look for products to improve their pet's health and wellness.

According to Packaged Facts, spending in the U.S. pet market has grown from $98 billion in 2019 to an estimated $157 billion in 2025, or at an 8.1% compounded annual growth rate ("CAGR") over that time. Packaged Facts projects the U.S. pet market to grow at an estimated CAGR of approximately 4% from 2025 through 2029.

Spending on pets is a necessity and most customers purchase frequently and at regular intervals. The pet industry is one of the most resilient categories during economic downturns because of the nature of the pet parent/pet relationship. For example, during the recession from 2008 to 2010, overall consumer spending in the U.S. declined while pet spending in the U.S. increased by 12%, according to the American Pet Products Association (the "APPA"). In 2010 alone, spending in the U.S. on entertainment decreased by 7.0%, food decreased by 3.8%, housing decreased by 2.0% and apparel and services decreased by 1.4%, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, while spending on pets increased by 6.2%, according to the APPA.

The pet industry, like many other industries in the U.S., continues to shift from in-store to online purchases as internet shopping continues to take market share from brick-and-mortar retail. Packaged Facts reports that online shopping grew from 24% of U.S. retail pet product sales in 2019 to an estimated 41% in 2025 with over $41 billion of pet food and treats sold online. This represents a 20% CAGR for online pet retail over that time frame.

According to Packaged Facts, 61% of pet product shoppers surveyed in January 2025 had purchased pet products through a website in the last 12 months, and 38% through a smartphone application. We believe consumers will continue to value the convenience of online shopping, including home delivery and subscription-based purchasing, as part of their broader purchasing behavior.

Additionally, according to a Packaged Facts survey conducted in January 2025, among those who buy pet products online, 49% have used an Autoship/subscription purchasing program within the last 12 months for pet-related products. According to Packaged Facts, 31% of pet parents surveyed in January 2025 used subscription-based purchasing for pet food, including treats and chews, in the prior 12 months. We believe that the trend of subscription-based purchasing behavior within the broader trend towards online shopping supports higher levels of customer retention and revenue visibility.
•Our commitment to customer service is the core of our brand.

◦Customer centricity. Everything about our company is organized around our commitment to provide an exceptional customer experience. We make the shopping experience easy and enjoyable, and that makes finding and buying the right product an amazing start to the customer journey. We provide competitive prices, customizable and convenient automatic reordering, fast and reliable order delivery, and innovative technology-driven services.

◦Customer service expertise that is knowledgeable and empowered. Our customer service representatives ("CSRs") share a common bond - they love pets. This shared passion is evident in every interaction they have with our customers, whether via phone, email, or interactive live-chat. In addition, contacting us is easy, with virtually all customer calls being answered in less than ten seconds. From the moment they join Chewy, our CSRs receive extensive training from our knowledgeable team, learning about the world of pets and our product offerings. Thereafter, they continue learning about brands and pets of all types via recurring training. This allows them to further hone their ability to deliver highly specialized, informed, and authentic advice to our customers.

◦Engaging with customers on a personalized level. We empower our CSRs to go above and beyond for our customers, and they do so with the knowledge that our commitment to our customers is our number one priority. We engage with pet parents thousands of times per day, and we embrace the opportunity to "WOW" our customers each time, from surprising them with a hand-painted pet portrait to sending personalized expressions of sympathy to a family who has recently lost their pet. In addition, we have developed integrated technology that enables us to capture profiles for each of our customers as well as their pets so that we may provide them with personalized recommendations. The expertise of our CSRs, combined with the tools that we provide them, allows us to deliver a high-touch and high-quality experience to our customers, which we believe results in higher retention rates.

•We offer a wide assortment of pet products and services across health and retail categories—and we continue to grow that assortment—which we offer at competitive prices. We carry approximately 4,000 carefully selected brands and approximately 190,000 products and service offerings, representing many of the best and most popular products, and we regularly add new products as we strive to offer everything that pet parents may need or want for their pets. In addition, we offer a wide range of free educational media (such as blogs, videos, and tutorials on our website, Chewy.com/education and pet health focused content on our website, PetMD.com) to enhance our product offerings and the buying experience, helping pet parents choose the right product for their pet or find answers to commonly asked questions specific to their type of pet. Additionally, we offer a wide range of pet health related products and services and operate the #1 pet pharmacy in America. In 2020, we launched medication compounding capabilities within our Chewy Pharmacy business and launched our telehealth service called "Connect with a Vet." In 2021, we expanded access to "Connect with a Vet" to all Chewy customers, with access remaining free of charge for our Autoship customers and in 2022, we further expanded this access to all registered Chewy customers. In 2022, we also launched CarePlus, our product suite of Insurance and Wellness plans offering comprehensive coverage options across varying price points. In 2023, we expanded our CarePlus suite of offerings, allowing us to meet the needs of a broader range of pet parents and increase access to affordable and high-quality pet healthcare offerings. In 2024, we opened and operated eight veterinary clinics under the brand name "Chewy Vet Care," offering pet health services including routine appointments, urgent care and surgery. Chewy Vet Care practices are powered by our own custom-built technology platform offering a seamless and efficient experience for pet parents and vet care providers alike. In 2025, we continued to expand our Chewy Vet Care practices, bringing the total number of clinics to 18.

headings: Risks Related to Ownership of Our Class A Common Stock
Risks Related to Our Business and Operations
Our recent growth rates may not be sustainable or indicative of our future growth and we may not be able to successfully manage challenges to our future growth.
Business disruptions and responsive actions may adversely affect our business operations, financial performance, liquidity and cash flow for an unknown period of time.
If we fail to acquire and retain new customers, or fail to do so in a cost-effective manner, we may be unable to increase net sales, improve margins, and maintain profitability.
If we fail to manage our growth effectively, our business, financial condition and results of operations could be materially and adversely affected.
Our continued success is in part dependent on positive perceptions of the Company.
Our operating expenses may increase over the next few years, and we may generate operating losses as we continue to expand our business.
We may be unable to accurately forecast net sales and appropriately plan our expenses in the future.
Our estimate of the size of our addressable markets may prove to be inaccurate.
We may be unable to source additional suppliers or strengthen our existing relationships with suppliers. In addition, the loss of any of our key suppliers would negatively impact our business.
Shipping is a critical part of our business and any changes in, or disruptions to, our shipping arrangements could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
If we do not successfully optimize, operate, and manage the expansion of the capacity of our fulfillment centers, our business, financial condition and results of operations could be harmed.
Our business may be adversely affected if we are unable to provide our customers with a cost-effective platform that is able to respond and adapt to rapid changes in technology.
We are subject to risks related to online payment methods.
Disruptions to SaaS technologies from third parties may adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and related notes thereto included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 ("10-K Report"). This discussion contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. As a result of many factors, such as those set forth under the "Risk Factors" and "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" sections herein, our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements. Unless the context requires otherwise, references in this 10-K Report to "Chewy," the "Company," "we," "our," or "us" refer to Chewy, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries.

Investors and others should note that we may announce material information to our investors using our investor relations website (https://investor.chewy.com/), filings with the SEC, press releases, public conference calls and webcasts. We use these channels, as well as social media, to communicate with our investors and the public about our company, our business and other issues. It is possible that the information that we post on these channels could be deemed to be material information. We therefore encourage investors to visit these websites from time to time. The information contained on such websites and social media posts is not incorporated by reference into this filing. Further, our references to website URLs in this filing are intended to be inactive textual references only.

We are the largest pet e-tailer in the United States, offering virtually every product a pet needs. We launched Chewy in 2011 to bring the best of the neighborhood pet store shopping experience to a larger audience, enhanced by the depth and wide selection of products and services, as well as the around-the-clock convenience, that only e-commerce can offer. We believe that we are the preeminent destination for pet parents as a result of our broad selection of high-quality products and expanded menu of service offerings, which we offer at great prices and deliver with an exceptional level of care and a personal touch. We are the trusted source for pet parents and partners and continually develop innovative ways for our customers to engage with us. We partner with approximately 4,000 of the best and most trusted brands in the pet industry, and we create and offer our own outstanding private brands. Through our websites and mobile applications, we offer our customers approximately 190,000 products, compelling merchandising, an easy and enjoyable shopping experience, and exceptional customer service.

Macroeconomic conditions, including inflationary pressures, elevated interest rates, and broader economic uncertainty, have influenced consumer spending patterns and may continue to affect demand across our categories. We monitor these conditions closely and adjust elements of our logistics, transportation, supply chain, and merchandising strategies as appropriate. Changes in consumer behavior may impact product mix, purchasing frequency, and promotional intensity, and we manage our operations with a focus on maintaining value, service levels, and operational discipline in varying economic environments.

We are unable to predict the duration and ultimate impact of evolving macroeconomic conditions on the broader economy or our operations and liquidity. As such, macroeconomic risks and uncertainties remain. Please refer to the "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" and the section titled "Risk Factors" in Item 1A of this 10-K Report.

We have a 52- or 53-week fiscal year ending each year on the Sunday that is closest to January 31 of that year. Our 2025 fiscal year ended February 1, 2026 and included 52 weeks ("Fiscal Year 2025"). Our 2024 fiscal year ended February 2, 2025 and included 53 weeks ("Fiscal Year 2024"). Our 2023 fiscal year ended January 28, 2024 and included 52 weeks ("Fiscal Year 2023").

We have provided restated financial and operating data for the historical comparative periods in Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations of this 10-K Report. For additional information related to this restatement, see section titled Basis of Presentation in Note 2 – Basis of Presentation and Significant Accounting Policies, in the "Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements" included in Part II, Item 8, Financial Statements and Supplementary Data, of this 10-K Report.

As of the last date of each reporting period, we determine our number of active customers by counting the total number of individual customers who have ordered a product or service, and for whom a product has shipped or for whom a service has been provided, at least once during the preceding 364-day period. The change in active customers in a reporting period captures both the inflow of new customers and the outflow of customers who have not made a purchase in the last 364 days. We view the number of active customers as a key indicator of our growth—acquisition and retention of customers—as a result of our marketing efforts and the value we provide to our customers. The number of active customers has grown over time as we acquired new customers and retained previously acquired customers.

We define net sales per active customer as the aggregate net sales for the preceding four fiscal quarters, divided by the total number of active customers at the end of that period. We view net sales per active customer as a key indicator of our customers' purchasing patterns, including their initial and repeat purchase behavior.

We define Autoship customers as customers in a given fiscal quarter that had an order shipped through our Autoship subscription program during the preceding 364-day period. We define Autoship as our subscription program, which provides automatic ordering, payment, and delivery of products to our customers. We view our Autoship subscription program as a key driver of recurring net sales and customer retention. For a given fiscal quarter, Autoship customer sales consist of sales and shipping revenues from all Autoship subscription program purchases and purchases outside of the Autoship subscription program by Autoship customers, excluding taxes collected from customers, excluding any refunds, and net of any promotional offers (such as percentage discounts off current purchases and other similar offers) for that quarter. For a given fiscal year, Autoship customer sales equal the sum of the Autoship customer sales for each of the fiscal quarters in that fiscal year.
Autoship Customer Sales as a Percentage of Net Sales

We define Autoship customer sales as a percentage of net sales as the Autoship customer sales in a given reporting period divided by the net sales from all orders in that period. We view Autoship customer sales as a percentage of net sales as a key indicator of our recurring sales and customer retention.

We derive net sales primarily from sales of both third-party brand and private brand pet food, pet products, pet health and specialty products, and related shipping fees. Consumable products include retail pet food and veterinary diet products. Hard goods products include non-perishable pet supplies. Pet health and specialty products include prescription medications, non-prescription pet health care products and certain specialty animal products for categories such as equine, birds, fish, and other non-traditional pets. Other net sales include private brand sales and certain pet-related services including telehealth services, pet insurance-related offerings, loyalty program memberships, and veterinary clinic services. Revenues from these service-based offerings are not a significant component of net sales and are managed as part of the Company's integrated platform rather than as standalone service offerings.

Sales of third-party brand and private brand pet food, pet products, pet health and specialty products, and shipping revenues are recorded when products are shipped, net of promotional discounts and refunds and allowances. Taxes collected from customers are excluded from net sales. Net sales is primarily driven by growth of new customers and active customers, and the frequency with which customers purchase and subscribe to our Autoship subscription program.

headings: "寵物人性化"及高階化帶動每隻寵物支出增加
歷史及預測的寵物支出成長
支出的穩定性及經濟衰退期間的韌性
快速轉向線上購物，仍有顯著成長空間
paragraphs: Chewy, Inc. 於 2011 年開始以 Chewy.com 運作，並於 2013 年 10 月成立 Chewy.com, LLC 為一家 Delaware 有限責任公司。於 2016 年 3 月 16 日，Chewy.com, LLC 從 Delaware 有限責任公司轉為 Delaware 股份有限公司，並更名為 Chewy, Inc. Chewy, Inc. 於 2019 年 6 月 18 日完成其 Class A 普通股（每股票面價值 $0.01）的首次公開發行（Initial Public Offering）。除非上下文另有明確要求，否則本年度報告（Form 10-K）中提及 "Chewy"、"Company"、"we"、"our" 或 "us" 均指 Chewy, Inc. 及其合併子公司。

我們的使命是成為全球寵物家長與合作夥伴最值得信賴且便利的購物目的地。我們相信，由於我們提供廣泛的高品質產品與服務，並以具有競爭力的價格銷售，並以卓越的照顧與個人化服務來交付，因此我們是線上寵物產品、用品與處方藥品的主要來源。我們致力於持續開發創新方式，讓客戶與我們互動，因為我們的網站與行動應用程式讓寵物家長可以管理他們寵物的健康、 wellness 以及商品需求，同時也能方便地購物。我們與約 4,000 家最受信任的寵物產業品牌合作，並創造與提供我們自己的自有品牌。透過我們的網站與行動應用程式，我們為客戶提供約 190,000 種產品與服務，以提供我們認為高標準、以客戶為中心的購物體驗。透過我們廣泛的供應鏈基礎設施，包含位於美國與加拿大的倉儲中心，我們通常能以本地化的方式提供產品，並能服務美國 80% 人口隔日達，幾乎 100% 在兩天內達成。
我們經營的產業為龐大且持續成長的寵物產業，包含寵物食品與零食、寵物用品與寵物藥品、其他寵物健康產品以及寵物服務。

寵物家長越來越將寵物視為家庭的一部分，並願意為這些家庭成員花更多錢購買更高品質的商品與服務。根據 Packaged Facts 的研究，美國 93% 的寵物飼養者認為他們的寵物是家庭的一份子。此外，86% 的寵物飼養者同意「寵物是他們家庭生活的核心」這句話，且 74% 的人會說他們自認為是「寵物家長」。另外，根據 Packaged Facts 的研究，四分之三的寵物家長會尋找產品來改善他們寵物的健康與 wellness。
根據 Packaged Facts 的資料，美國寵物市場的支出從 2019 年的 98 十億美元成長至 2025 年預估的 157 十億美元，成長率為該期間每年 8.1% 的複合年成長率（"CAGR"）。Packaged Facts 預測，美國寵物市場將在 2025 年至 2029 年間以約 4% 的 CAGR 成長。

寵物支出屬於必要開支，大多數客戶會定期且間隔固定時間進行購買。寵物產業是經濟衰退期間最具有韌性的產業之一，這是因為寵物家長與寵物之間的關係本質。例如，在 2008 至 2010 年的經濟衰退期間，美國整體消費支出下降，但美國寵物支出卻成長了 12%，根據美國寵物產品協會（American Pet Products Association，簡稱 APPA）的資料。根據美國勞工統計局的資料，2010 年美國在娛樂方面的支出減少 7.0%，食品減少 3.8%，住房減少 2.0%，服飾與服務減少 1.4%，但根據 APPA 的資料，寵物支出卻成長了 6.2%。
如同美國許多其他產業，寵物產業持續從實體店面轉向線上購物，因網路購物持續從實體零售業奪取市場佔有率。Packaged Facts 報告指出，線上購物在 2019 年佔美國零售寵物產品銷售的 24%，預估在 2025 年將成長至 41%，線上銷售的寵物食品與零食總額超過 41 十億美元。這代表該期間線上寵物零售業的成長率為 20% 的 CAGR。
根據 Packaged Facts 的資料，2025 年 1 月進行調查的 61% 的寵物產品購物者表示，他們在過去 12 個月內透過網站購買了寵物產品，38% 透過智慧型手機應用程式。我們相信消費者會持續重視網購的便利性，包括宅配與訂閱式購買新興模式，作為他們廣泛購買新行為的一部分。

此外，根據 Packaged Facts 於 2025 年 1 月進行的調查，購買寵物產品的消費者中，有 49% 在過去 12 個月內曾使用 Autoship/訂閱購買新的寵物相關產品。根據 Packaged Facts 的資料，2025 年 1 月調查的寵物飼養者中，有 31% 在過去 12 個月內使用訂閱式購買新的寵物糧食，包括零食和咀嚼玩具。我們認為，訂閱式購買新興趨勢屬於整體在線購物趨勢的一部分，有助於提高客戶留存率與營業收入的可預測性。
• 我們對客戶服務的承諾是我們品牌的中心。
◦ 以客戶為中心。我們公司的所有運作都圍繞我們對提供卓越客戶體驗的承諾。我們讓購物體驗變得輕鬆愉快，這讓客戶在旅程的開始就能找到並購買正確的產品。我們提供具有競爭力的價格、可自訂且便利的自動補貨、快速可靠的訂單配送，以及創新科技驅動的服務。

◦ 擁有知識且具備權限的客戶服務專業知識。我們的客戶服務代表（"CSRs"）有一個共同點 - 他們愛寵物。這份共通的熱情在他們與客戶的每一次互動中都清晰可見，無論是透過電話、電子郵件或即時聊天。此外，與我們聯繫非常容易，幾乎所有客戶電話都在 10 秒內得到回應。從他們加入 Chewy 的那一刻起，我們的 CSRs 會接受我們知識豐富團隊的廣泛培訓，學習有關寵物世界和我們產品的知識。之後，他們會透過持續的培訓，學習不同類型的品牌和寵物知識。這讓他們能進一步提升提供高度專業、資訊豐富且真實建議的能力。

◦ 以個性化方式與客戶互動。我們賦予 CSRs 去為客戶做更多事情的權力，他們也確實這麼做，並知道我們對客戶的承諾是我們的第一優先事項。我們每天與數千名寵物飼養者互動，我們把握每次機會去 "驚喜" 我們的客戶，從驚喜他們以手繪寵物畫像到為剛失去寵物的家庭寄送個性化的慰問訊息。此外，我們已開發整合性科技，使我們能為每位客戶及其寵物建立資料檔案，以便提供個性化的推薦。我們 CSRs 的專業知識，加上我們為他們提供的工具，使我們能為客戶提供高接觸且高品質的體驗，我們認為這會提高客戶留存率。

• 我們提供涵蓋健康與零售類別的廣泛寵物產品與服務，並持續擴充此產品組合，我們以具有競爭力的價格提供這些產品與服務。我們約有 4,000 個經過精心挑選的品牌，以及約 190,000 個產品與服務項目，代表許多最佳且最熱門的產品，我們會定期新增產品，以期提供所有寵物飼養者所需或想要的產品。此外，我們提供廣泛的免費教育媒體（例如網站 Chewy.com/education 上的部落格、影片和教學影片，以及專注於寵物健康的內容在網站 PetMD.com），以增強我們的產品組合與購物體驗，協助寵物飼養者為他們的寵物選擇正確的產品或找到與他們寵物類型相關的常見問題解答。此外，我們也提供廣泛的寵物健康相關產品與服務，並經營美國排名第一的寵物藥房。2020 年，我們在 Chewy 藥房業務中啟動藥物製備能力，並推出名為 "Connect with a Vet" 的遠距醫療服務。2021 年，我們將 "Connect with a Vet" 的服務擴展至所有 Chewy 用戶，並保持對 Autoship 用戶免費。2022 年，我們進一步將此服務擴展至所有註冊的 Chewy 用戶。2022 年，我們也推出了 CarePlus，這是一套包含保險與健康計畫的產品組合，提供不同價格點的全面保障選項。2023 年，我們擴充了 CarePlus 的產品組合，使我們能滿足更廣泛的寵物飼養者需求，並提高可負擔且高品質的寵物醫療服務的可近性。2024 年，我們開設並營運了八間以品牌名 "Chewy Vet Care" 註冊的獸醫診所，提供包括常規檢查、緊急照護與手術的寵物健康服務。Chewy Vet Care 的診所由我們自建的科技平台支援，為寵物飼養者與獸醫照護提供者提供順暢且高效的體驗。2025 年，我們持續擴展 Chewy Vet Care 的診所，使診所總數達到 18 間。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與本年度財務報表及相關附註說明一併閱讀，財務報表為 2025 年度年報（"10-K 報告"）。本討論包含風險與不確定性之預測性陳述。由於許多因素，例如本報告 "風險因素" 及 "預測性陳述警示" 章節所列者，我們實際結果可能與預測性陳述中所預期者有重大差異。除非上下文另有明確要求，否則本 10-K 報告中提及 "Chewy"、"本公司"、"我們"、"我們的" 或 "我們公司"，均指 Chewy, Inc. 及其合併子公司。

投資人及其他人士應注意，我們可能透過投資人關係網站（https://investor.chewy.com/）、向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交的申報文件、新聞稿、公開電話會議及網路直播，向投資人公告重要資訊。我們使用這些通訊渠道，以及社交媒體，與投資人及公眾溝通我們的公司、業務及其他議題。我們張貼在這些通訊渠道的資訊可能被視為重要資訊。因此，我們鼓勵投資人定期造訪這些網站。這些網站及社交媒體發文的資訊並未納入本申報文件之參考。此外，本申報文件中提及的網站網址僅為無動態功能的文字參考。

我們是美國最大的寵物電子零售商，提供幾乎所有寵物所需的商品。我們於2011年推出Chewy，以將 neighbourhood 寵物商店的購物體驗帶給更廣大的羣眾，並透過商品與服務的深度與廣度，以及只有電子商務才能提供的全天候便利性加以提升。我們相信，由於我們廣泛的高品質商品選擇與擴充的服務項目，我們成為寵物家長的首選目的地，並以優質價格提供，並以卓越的照顧與個人化服務交付。我們是寵物家長與合作夥伴的可靠來源，並持續開發創新方式讓客戶與我們互動。我們與約4,000家最受信任的寵物產業品牌合作，並創造與提供我們自己的優秀自有品牌。透過我們的網站與行動應用程式，我們為客戶提供約190,000種商品、強力的商品展示、輕鬆愉快的購物體驗與卓越的客戶服務。
總體經濟條件，包括通貨膨脹壓力、高利率及更廣泛的經濟不確定性，已影響消費者支出模式，並可能繼續影響我們各類別的產品需求。我們密切監測這些條件，並根據需要調整物流、運輸、供應鏈與商品展示策略。消費者行為的變化可能影響產品組合、購買頻率與促銷強度，我們以維持價值、服務水準與運營紀律為重點，管理我們的運營，以應對不同經濟環境。
我們無法預測不斷變化的總體經濟條件對整體經濟或我們運營與流動性的持續影響與最終影響。因此，總體經濟風險與不確定性仍然存在。請參閱本10-K報告中「預測性陳述警示」及「風險因素」部分，位於第1A項。
我們的財務年度為52或53週，每年結束於最接近該年1月31日的星期日。我們2025財務年度於2026年2月1日結束，包含52週（「財務年度2025」）。我們2024財務年度於2025年2月2日結束，包含53週（「財務年度2024」）。我們2023財務年度於2024年1月28日結束，包含52週（「財務年度2023」）。
我們已在管理層對財務狀況與營運成果的討論與分析中，提供歷史比較期間的重列財務與營運資料。有關此重列的更多資訊，請參閱本10-K報告中「財務報表附註」部分，第2節「財務報表編製基礎與重要會計政策」，以及「合併財務報表附註」，包含於第二部分第8項「財務報表與補充資料」。
在每個會計期間的最後一天，我們根據過去364天內至少有一次訂購商品或服務，且商品已出貨或服務已提供之個別客戶總數，來計算我們的活躍客戶數。會計期間內活躍客戶數的變化，反映新客戶的流入與過去364天內未進行購買之客戶的流出。我們將活躍客戶數視為衡量我們成長的重要指標—客戶的獲取與留存—這是由我們的行銷努力與我們為客戶提供的價值所驅動。隨著我們獲取新客戶並留存原有客戶，活躍客戶數已隨時間增長。
我們將淨銷售額每活躍客戶定義為前四個財務季度的總淨銷售額，除以該期間結束時的總活躍客戶數。我們將淨銷售額每活躍客戶視為衡量客戶購買新模式的重要指標，包括其首次購買與重複購買行為。

我們將 Autoship 客戶定義為在某一財務季度內，其在前 364 天內曾透過我們的 Autoship 訂閱計劃下達過訂單的客戶。我們將 Autoship 定義為我們的訂閱計劃，該計劃提供自動訂購、付款與產品配送服務。我們將 Autoship 訂閱計劃視為再購淨銷售額與客戶留存的重要驅動因素。對於某一財務季度，Autoship 客戶銷售包含所有 Autoship 訂閱計劃購買與非 Autoship 訂閱計劃購買的銷售與運費收入，扣除向客戶收取的稅款、扣除任何退款，並扣除該季度的促銷優惠（例如現購折扣或其他類似優惠）。
Autoship 客戶銷售佔淨銷售額百分比
我們將 Autoship 客戶銷售佔淨銷售額百分比定義為某一報告期間的 Autoship 客戶銷售額除以該期間所有訂單的淨銷售額。我們將 Autoship 客戶銷售佔淨銷售額百分比視為衡量我們再購銷售與客戶留存的重要指標。

我們的淨銷售額主要來自第三方品牌與自有品牌寵物食品、寵物用品、寵物健康與專業產品，以及相關的運費收入。消耗性產品包括零售寵物食品與獸醫飲食產品。硬體產品包括非易腐寵物用品。寵物健康與專業產品包括處方藥物、非處方寵物保健產品以及某些專業動物產品，例如馬、鳥、魚及其他非傳統寵物類別。其他淨銷售額包括自有品牌銷售與某些與寵物相關的服務，例如遠距醫療服務、寵物保險相關服務、忠誠度計畫會員資格與獸醫診所服務。來自這些服務型產品的收入並非淨銷售額的重要組成部分，而是作為本公司整合平台的一部分進行管理，而非作為獨立的服務產品。
第三方品牌與自有品牌寵物食品、寵物用品、寵物健康與專業產品以及運費收入在產品發送時確認，扣除促銷折扣與退款與允許的折扣。向客戶收取的稅款不包含在淨銷售額內。淨銷售額主要由新客戶與活躍客戶的成長以及客戶購買頻率與訂閱 Autoship 訂閱計劃的次數所驅動。

與本公司A類普通股投資相關的風險
與我們業務及營運相關的風險
本公司近期的成長率可能無法持續或反映未來成長，且我們可能無法成功應對未來成長所面臨的挑戰。
業務中斷及應對措施可能對我們的業務營運、財務表現、流動性及現金流造成不利影響，時間長短無法預測。
若我們無法取得並留住新客戶，或無法以成本效益的方式取得與留住新客戶，我們可能無法提高淨銷售額、改善毛利率及維持獲利能力。
若我們無法有效管理成長，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。
本公司持續的成功在部分程度上取決於外界對本公司的正面看法。
我們的營運費用可能在未來幾年增加，且在持續擴展業務的過程中，我們可能產生營運虧損。
我們可能無法準確預測淨銷售額，並適當地規劃我們的費用。
我們對可接觸市場規模的估計可能證明是不準確的。
我們可能無法尋找額外的供應商或強化與現有供應商的關係。此外，任何關鍵供應商的流失將對我們的業務產生負面影響。
運輸是我們業務的重要組成部分，任何運輸安排的變動或中斷都可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
如果我們無法成功優化、運作及管理我們履行中心容量的擴張，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成損害。
如果我們無法為客戶提供一個具成本效益的平台，以回應並適應技術快速變化的趨勢，將可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
本公司面臨與線上付款方式相關之風險。
來自第三方之 SaaS 技術中斷，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 下列為可能影響本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果之重要因素，並可能導致未來期間之實際結果與本公司預期結果或其他預期有重大差異，包括任何於本年度10-K表報表中所發表之預測性陳述、本公司其他向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交之文件，或於公開電話會議及網路簡報中所發表之預測性陳述。您應仔細考量下列因素，並與本年度10-K表報表一併參考，包括第7項「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」，以及第8項之合併財務報表及相關附註。下列所描述之風險與不確定性並非本公司所面臨之唯一風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，可能為本公司未察覺，或目前認為不具重大影響，但未來可能成為影響本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果之重要因素。若任何上述風險實際發生，或本公司未察覺之其他風險成為重大影響，則本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果與未來展望可能受到重大且不利之影響。
本公司業務面臨重大風險。下列所描述之風險因素僅為投資本公司之主要風險因素之摘要。這些風險在本「風險因素」節中更為詳細說明，包括以下內容：
與本公司業務及營運相關之風險
•本公司近期之成長率可能無法持續或反映未來成長，且本公司可能無法成功管理未來成長所面臨之挑戰。
•業務中斷及應對措施可能對本公司業務營運、財務表現、流動性及現金流造成不確定期間之負面影響。
•若本公司無法取得並留住新客戶，或無法以成本效益方式取得並留住新客戶，則本公司可能無法增加淨銷售額、改善毛利率，並維持獲利能力。
